notes.title: New Update: The Fear Continues
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181180/Crib/


Our journey into Milton's dark past continues. In this new update, there are renovations to the mansion and dormitory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579595/7dbb62bbae0d51f8be54007b8d65077a7adeab5c.jpg[/img]

* Mysterious rooms in the dormitory have been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579595/0fb886c5b7ad287d947cc5b527b43a1247edf525.jpg[/img]

* There are many batteries waiting in secret places for those who want more light. Of course, you need to search and find them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579595/b168179cf2eba6c6b165faefb9790812a031dea7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfixes for CRIB
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181180/Crib/


The following hotfixes have been released before a major update for CRIB

* Adjusted battery counts for the story in the first mansion. Now you have more batteries.

* Adjusted lighting for the second mansion. Made the environments more appealing.

notes.title: CRIB Out Now !
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2181180/Crib/


[h2]CRIB Out Now ![/h2]

It's time to face! As Milton, your past invites you to solve the mysteries. What you learn about yourself will surprise you. Most importantly remember that this is not a nightmare, this is a reality.

Through Milton's eyes, you will see his dark past and solve this mystery with various puzzles and answer Milton 'who you are?'.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MBH-mSzCFeA
